Package com.solace.connectors.tracing.api

Class SolaceMessageAttributes

java.lang.Object
com.solace.connectors.tracing.api.SolaceMessageAttributes
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SolaceMessageAttributes extends Object implements Serializable
Attributes of a message received by the listener. traceparent/tracestate identify the listener's receive span: pass them to the publish operation so the next hop becomes its child.
